contrast.claim: Contrast counts are separate from build success and from subjective visual preference.

knownDefects.note: Catalog palette order still places the red accent last, and a six-digit #111111 swatch is not the resolved #111 text. Preview, CSS export, and selected handoff use the semantic roles. A consumer that maps palette[length-1] to text recreates issue #4.
These are differences between the display palette and the resolved semantic roles. They are not a claim that every difference is a rendering bug.
The recipe names a light alternate that is still visually dark. The contract builder does not advertise that mode.
Invalid authored shadow syntax is exported as none rather than a generic soft shadow or a claimed computed shadow.
The authored canvas gradient is not a role color. The contract uses an explicit flat fallback. Backdrop contrast stays needs-rendered-review.

UI language ja does not add a Japanese shell font. Content-locale resolution can still insert Noto Sans JP into a font stack. Those are different mechanisms; this capture did not observe a browser font download.
Authored body line-height is null. Korean resolution raises the recipe value to the 1.65 locale floor. The field expectations pin the resulting numbers.

budgetChecks.reason: Reviewed after measuring 141,663 B versus baseline79,875 B. The synchronous validated workspace/shared visual resolver intentionally moves code into the entry. Whole route module closures below prevent chunk partitioning from hiding actual growth; this is an initial JS cost, not a performance gain.

Baseline149,051 B; first complete implementation224,336 B (+50.5%). Reviewed cost of functional specimen, semantic contracts, local resolution and persistent validated state. Excludes CSS/font/media transfer, which needs browser measurement.
Baseline110,546 B; first implementation179,918 B. Reviewed absolute ceiling for complete local semantic editing, validation, specimen and export; includes entry and static dependencies.
New editor measured184,893 B; no equivalent baseline editor. Includes full role editing, font metadata/fallback state, specimen and export.
Baseline108,727 B; first implementation180,485 B. Reviewed absolute ceiling for shared-content and axis comparison with preserved draft state.
Baseline152,748 B; first implementation186,025 B. Reviewed ceiling for exact draft handoff and locked-scope refinement, not all-reference content.
Baseline 944,130 B across all lazy routes. Allows complete visual contracts and editor behavior; catches accidental corpus or duplicated dependencies.
Baseline 241,230 B across all lazy routes. Small allowance for shared specimens/editor controls; does not authorize a second gallery stylesheet.
Baseline global CSS requested 27 families. Font loading now belongs to the active shell/specimen loader; no all-catalog global import may return. Actual browser font requests are checked separately.
New selected handoff includes exact role typography, provenance and honest checks; 32 KB is a bounded one-style payload, independently guarded against unrelated catalog/locales.

The same one-style static handoff plus a bounded implementation preface. Measures every style and content locale with empty user project context; user-authored project text is additional explicit input.

discovery.note: Discovery documents intentionally index styles and references. Their size is not the selected-handoff budget. generatedAt changes the hash and keeps a fixed ISO length, so bytes are pinned and hashes are not.
